edges.reason: onlyOwner derives authorization directly from untrusted msg.sender via ownable.allowed(msg.sender).
msg.sender is pushed into players[game] when a ticket is bought.
msg.sender may become players[game][winner] and receive the jackpot transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the entropy time parameter into randomNumber().
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 pseudo-random derivation.
block.timestamp is used directly as randomness seed when picking the winner.
The keccak-based number produced by the unsafe randomness operation selects the winner index.
pickTheWinner calls randomNumber to choose the winning player.
The winner ETH transfer executes before paidToPartners is reset to zero.
paidToPartners is only incremented after the external partner.transfer send completes.
paidToPartners is only incremented after the external salesPartner.transfer send completes.
The low-level value call to fundsDistributor happens while paidToPartners still holds stale partner payouts.
fundsDistributor receives value through call() and can re-enter pickTheWinner before state is finalized.
The external transfer to the winner is a callback point reached before game accounting is completed.
pickTheWinner transfers the jackpot share to the winning player.
pickTheWinner forwards the commission share to fundsDistributor with a low-level call.
distribute -= paidToPartners performs unchecked unsigned subtraction against partner payouts.
The arithmetically derived distribute value is the wei amount passed to the fundsDistributor call.
pickTheWinner performs the commission arithmetic that produces distribute.
transferToPartner performs the external partner transfer before bookkeeping settles.
transferToSalesPartner performs the external sales partner transfer before bookkeeping settles.
processReferralSystem triggers transferToPartner for the resolved partner.
buyTicket calls processReferralSystem with the supplied partner and msg.sender.
The payable fallback forwards the received ether to buyTicket.
start picks the winner when the current game already has players.
start begins a new game through startGame.
buyTicket increases jackpot[game] by msg.value.
buyTicket appends msg.sender to players[game].
buyTicket requires msg.value to equal the ticketPrice state variable.
startGame assigns the current game number from block.number.
startGame applies and clears the pending newPrice value.
startGame applies the pending isActive status toggle.
changeTicketPrice writes the staged price into newPrice.
toogleActive sets isActive back to true when the game is inactive.
toogleActive flips the toogleStatus request flag.
pickTheWinner reads players[game] to determine the winner and counts.
pickTheWinner reads and drains jackpot[game].
pickTheWinner accumulates the payout into allTimeJackpot.
pickTheWinner accumulates the player count into allTimePlayers.
pickTheWinner performs an external stats.newWinner call to log the result.
pickTheWinner reads fundsDistributor to send the commission.
onlyOwner performs an external ownable.allowed call to authorize msg.sender.
onlyOwner guards the toogleActive administrative entry point.
onlyOwner guards the start administrative entry point.
onlyOwner guards the changeTicketPrice administrative entry point.
The constructor instantiates the ownable interface at the supplied address.
The constructor instantiates the stats aggregator interface.
The constructor instantiates the referral system interface.
The constructor stores the funds distributor address.
The constructor calls startGame to initialize the first game.
processReferralSystem performs an external getPartnerByReferral call.
processReferralSystem performs an external addReferral call to register the partner.
transferToPartner performs an external getPartnerByReferral call.
transferToPartner computes the payout through getPartnerAmount.
transferToPartner cascades to transferToSalesPartner after paying the partner.
transferToSalesPartner performs an external getSalesPartner call.
transferToSalesPartner computes the payout through getSalesPartnerAmount.
getPartnerAmount performs an external getPartnerPercent call.
getPartnerAmount derives the amount via calculateReferral.
getSalesPartnerAmount performs an external getSalesPartnerPercent call.
getSalesPartnerAmount derives the amount via calculateReferral.
calculateReferral uses ticketPrice as the payout base.
calculateReferral uses the fee percentage in its computation.

playGame argument is a call argument of the getPlayersInGame view helper.
The price parameter is the sole input of the changeTicketPrice administrative function.
min is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
max is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
time is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
difficulty is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
number is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
bHash is an input of the randomNumber computation function.
ownableContract is a constructor argument stored in the ownable state variable.
distributor is a constructor argument stored in the fundsDistributor state variable.
statsA is a constructor argument stored in the stats state variable.
referralSystem is a constructor argument stored in the referralInstance state variable.
The partner parameter is consumed by processReferralSystem.
The referral parameter is consumed by processReferralSystem.
The referral parameter drives the lookup and payout in transferToPartner.
The locally resolved partner address is used only inside transferToPartner.
The partner parameter drives the lookup and payout in transferToSalesPartner.
The partner parameter is the lookup key of getPartnerAmount.
The partner parameter is the lookup key of getSalesPartnerAmount.
The percent parameter is the computation input of calculateReferral.
The winner index is a temporary indexing variable inside pickTheWinner.
toPlayer is the exact value passed to the winner transfer unsafe operation.
distribute is the exact value passed to the fundsDistributor low-level call.
playerNumber is a bookkeeping local inside buyTicket.
partnerRef is a resolution local inside processReferralSystem.
sum is the exact value passed to the partner transfer unsafe operation.
result captures the success flag of the fundsDistributor low-level call.
The partner local address is resolved and used only inside transferToPartner.
